0022600096.text: Minnesota (1-0, 2nd in the Northwest, 4th in the West) is playing its second game of the season, while Orlando (0-1, 4th in the Southeast, 1 game back, 11th in the East) is also still early. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury following surgery, and Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves lost both games to Orlando in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
